screens.title: Inbox (Interactive)
screens.prompt:
Regenerate the Inbox screen to add interactive links:
1. The settings gear icon in the top app bar must navigate to the Settings screen ({{DATA:SCREEN:SCREEN_9}}).
2. Tapping any task card (e.g., ул. Макаёнка, 9) must navigate to the Task Details screen ({{DATA:SCREEN:SCREEN_11}}).
3. The 'Closed' (Закрытые) icon in the bottom navigation bar must navigate to the Closed Tasks screen ({{DATA:SCREEN:SCREEN_13}}).
Maintain the exact visual style, Russian labels, and Beltelecom brand palette (#663479 purple, #33CEE1 cyan). Use standard cursor-pointer on all clickable areas.

outputComponents.text:
I've updated the **Inbox** screen with interactive links to complete your prototype flow:

- **Settings Gear**: Tapping the gear icon in the top-right corner now opens the **Settings** screen.
- **Task Cards**: Clicking on a task card (like the one for "ул. Макаёнка, 9") leads to the **Task Details** view.
- **Bottom Navigation**: The **Closed** icon in the bottom menu now navigates to the **Closed Tasks** screen.

The Beltelecom brand identity, Russian labels, and existing layout have been strictly preserved. You can now test these transitions directly in the Stitch preview.
